control_selection.resume_rule: Normal backlog selection remains denied until an independent audit confirms that the highest-ranked work is genuinely missing product-critical behavior. After acceptance, selection remains bounded to these integrated-runtime slices until the core outcome is qualified.

core_statement: ProjectPipeline shall continuously take a project from intake through verified modeling, autonomous selection, conflict-safe parallel execution, verification, governed repository integration, Jira reconciliation, project-state recomputation, and next-work selection without requiring a human to drive each development session.
immediate_pursuing_milestones: Repair product definition, source coverage, requirements, plans, Jira, Control selection, and Completion Gate semantics.
Implement the missing integrated Autonomy Runtime.
Prove one complete local-real autonomous project journey.
Qualify live GitHub/Jira and worker/provider integrations where authorized.
Qualify the Command Center and Windows runtime.
Pass unattended 24-hour and then 72-hour operating-loop qualifications.
Complete security, resilience, deployment, release, and post-release verification.
Keep the pursuing goal INCOMPLETE until all terminal conditions pass.
pursuing_goal: Deliver and qualify ProjectPipeline as a continuously operating, local-first autonomous engineering organization that accepts complete project inputs, compiles a verified project model, autonomously selects and executes genuinely missing work through conflict-safe parallel lanes and qualified workers, verifies results, governs GitHub and Jira, merges accepted changes, reconciles external state, recomputes project state, handles HUMAN_REQUIRED incidents without stopping unaffected work, exposes truthful live state through the Command Center, and continues until the project’s deterministic Completion Gate reports COMPLETE for the integrated, released, and operationally verified system.

vertical_slices.outcome: Repair product definition, source coverage, requirements, plans, Jira, Control selection, and Completion Gate semantics.
Deliver a persistent autonomy supervisor composing intake, verified modeling, selection, context, routing, dispatch, verification, and next-work continuation.
Deliver conflict-safe parallel lanes, durable leases and fencing, bounded recovery, unknown-outcome reconciliation, and HUMAN_REQUIRED continuation semantics.
Prove a local-real isolated Git/worktree journey with governed PR/merge simulation, Jira reconciliation, project-state recomputation, restart, worker loss, and unaffected-lane continuation.
Qualify authorized live GitHub/Jira and worker/provider dispatch plus truthful Command Center and Windows service operation.
Pass recovery, 24-hour and 72-hour unattended operation, release, post-release verification, and final deterministic Completion Gate.
